class.name: WarcryClient
class.brief_description: Opus voice client that talks to an out-of-tree Politeia / Warcry server over ENet.
class.description: `WarcryClient` is the engine singleton exposed as `Warcry`. It encodes 48 kHz mono 20 ms microphone frames with Opus, sends [code]VoiceFrameHeader[/code] plus raw Opus on ENet channel 1, and exchanges Politeia control JSON on channel 0 ([code]HELLO[/code], [code]AUTH[/code], channels, mute, user preferences). There is no in-engine mixer or server; connect to a running [code]politeia_server[/code]. Call [method poll] once per frame if you disable the automatic SceneTree hook. Attach playback with [method get_playback_stream] on an [AudioStreamPlayer], or call [method setup_audio_io] to create capture and playback nodes.

method.name: authenticate
method.description: Sends [code]AUTH[/code] so the server can elevate the session to admin or moderator. Returns [code]false[/code] if the ENet peer is not connected.

method.name: connect_to_server
method.description: Creates a 2-channel ENet client and starts connecting. [code]HELLO[/code] is sent after the CONNECT event. The [signal connected] signal fires on [code]HELLO_ACK[/code].

method.name: disconnect_from_server
method.description: Drops the peer immediately and clears cached users and channels.

method.name: get_channels
method.description: Cached channels from [code]SERVER_STATE[/code]. Each dictionary has [code]id[/code], [code]name[/code], and [code]member_count[/code].

method.name: get_current_channel
method.description: Local user's current channel id, or [code]0[/code] if unknown.

method.name: get_local_user_id
method.description: Id assigned in [code]HELLO_ACK[/code].

method.name: get_playback_stream
method.description: 48 kHz [AudioStreamGenerator] used for decoded mix-down from the server.

method.name: get_users
method.description: Cached users from [code]SERVER_STATE[/code]. Each dictionary has [code]id[/code], [code]username[/code], [code]channel_id[/code], [code]muted[/code], and [code]deaf[/code].

method.name: is_client_connected
method.description: True when the ENet peer is in the connected state. Named to avoid clashing with [method Object.is_connected].

method.name: is_speaking
method.description: True after [method start_speaking] until [method stop_speaking] (push-to-talk).

method.name: join_channel
method.description: Sends [code]JOIN_CHANNEL[/code].

method.name: leave_channel
method.description: Sends [code]LEAVE_CHANNEL[/code].

method.name: poll
method.description: Services ENet and encodes a capture frame when speaking. The module also hooks [code]SceneTree.process_frame[/code] when a tree exists.

method.name: set_capture_effect
method.description: Microphone tap. Requires [code]audio/driver/enable_input[/code] and an [AudioStreamMicrophone] playing into the capture bus.

method.name: set_deaf
method.description: Locally stops playback and sends [code]USER_STATE[/code].

method.name: set_master_volume
method.description: Linear gain applied to decoded frames (0 to 2).

method.name: set_muted
method.description: Stops sending voice and sends [code]USER_STATE[/code].

method.name: set_playback
method.description: Bind the generator playback created by an [AudioStreamPlayer] after [method AudioStreamPlayer.play].

method.name: set_user_preference
method.description: Sends [code]USER_PREFERENCE[/code] for per-user volume and mute on the server mixer.

method.name: setup_audio_io
method.description: Creates a muted [code]WarcryCap[/code] bus with [AudioEffectCapture], plus optional [code]WarcryPlayback[/code] and [code]WarcryMic[/code] players under [param parent].

method.name: start_speaking
method.description: Enables push-to-talk capture encode.

method.name: stop_speaking
method.description: Disables push-to-talk capture encode.

signal.name: server_state
signal.description: Emitted after a [code]SERVER_STATE[/code] update has been merged.
